statement: A release verifier that reads a different private repository through ambient developer credentials can pass locally while being structurally unable to pass under a workflow's default same-repository GITHUB_TOKEN. That local pass was never evidence that the check worked in CI because it did not exercise CI's authority boundary. When the contract is the artifact readers actually receive, read its deployed public surface, pin that source in a regression guard, and prove the verifier under the workflow's real credential scope before treating it as a release gate. Move condition: anchors when the issue #233 repair PR merges; verify the squash commit on origin/main reads the leaderboard from https://cejel.dev/leaderboard/leaderboard.md, removes the cross-repository private-content dependency, and adds the exact public-URL regression guard; then copy into Alfred maeve-lesson-batches with the cejel_ filename prefix and that origin/main anchor.
